summary: Phase G — major feature batch (avatar upload, profile state/zip/country, admin join_date recompute, RSVP guests, anniversary parent + 5 sub-events, all_access check-in ticket type, chat email digest queue/cancel, individual email blast). 18/18 backend pytest cases PASS. Frontend UI verified end-to-end on /profile, /admin (Members + Email Compose), and /events/{anniversary_parent} + /events/{sip_and_paint}. All data-testid hooks present and correctly wired. Live preview on Email Compose with Individual Member segment correctly shows 'Recipients: 1' and sample = picked member. EditMemberDialog expires preview updates live (2025-03-10 → Mar 10, 2026 = +365d).

issues: Radix Dialog missing Description / aria-describedby (a11y warning printed in console). Cosmetic — does not affect functionality but should be addressed for screen-reader users.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is now 3969 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into modules (events.py, chat.py, email.py, members.py, auth.py, seed.py). Deferred to backlog per user choice 1c, but flagging for future-iteration prioritization.

POST /api/events/{id}/rsvp uses toggle semantics (same endpoint adds AND removes). This is functionally fine but couples DELETE semantics to a POST and led to non-deterministic test state until tests added explicit reset helpers. Consider a separate DELETE /api/events/{id}/rsvp for clarity.

queue_chat_notifications creates one row per recipient per message rather than upserting against a (recipient_id, conversation_id, status='pending') key. This means a chatty thread can accumulate many pending rows for the same recipient+conversation; the digest loop must aggregate them (verified in _send_chat_digest_email). Functionally correct, just denser than needed. Optional optimization: upsert on (recipient_id, conversation_id) with the earliest due_at + append to an aggregated preview list.

Avatar upload reads the full file into memory before bouncing to put_object (line 3805–3826). For the 10MB cap this is fine, but if the cap is raised later this should be streamed to object storage. Low priority.

Camera capture path (AvatarUploader) gracefully renders data-testid='avatar-cam-error' when getUserMedia is denied — confirmed via codepath review; not exercised in headless test per agent_to_agent_context_note.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (profile state/zip/country persistence, anniversary 5 sub-events, RSVP+guests UI, EditMemberDialog live expires preview, Email Compose individual segment + live recipient_count=1)

seed_data_creation: Test data created during runs: TEST_GuestA/B (RSVP guests), UI_Guest_A/B (UI guests), one avatar file in object storage under avatars/{member_id}/. Demo member maya.patel had join_date changed to 2025-06-15 for the recompute test — note this may affect other tests that rely on her original membership_expires_at. Banquet event has one check-in record for member@clubhaven.app with ticket_type='all_access'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase G is fully verified. To re-run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://club-express-lite.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_phase_g.py -v. The anniversary parent event id was 444769bf-5a23-4ed8-973c-ad0e6e187cda and Sip&Paint sub-event was 55d34605-a7aa-4add-9d85-15141f7ac066 at testing time. chat_notifications collection had 4 rows (all cancelled) at end of test — proving the queue → cancel flow works end-to-end via /conversations/{id}/messages then /conversations/{id}/read. Background digest loop _chat_digest_loop runs every 60s (verified started in lifespan event); 5-min wait not exercised but the doc shape (due_at = created_at + 5min, status='pending'/'cancelled') is correct.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Two initial test failures were artifacts of pre-existing RSVP/check-in state from manual smoke-testing and were fixed by adding explicit reset helpers in test_phase_g.py (not production code changes).
